questions.question: Q1 Why do electronic devices such as GPUs generate heat during operation?

answers.b: Because they absorb heat from the monitor
answers.c: Because they are made of metal

explanations.a: Correct. Electrical energy is partially converted into heat during operation.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Monitors do not significantly contribute to GPU heating.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Material alone does not cause heating.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Fans help remove heat rather than generate it.

questions.question: Q2 What is the primary purpose of a cooling system in a computer?

answers.b: To reduce heat and maintain safe operation

explanations.a: Incorrect. Cooling systems do not affect network performance.
explanations.b: Correct. Cooling systems remove excess heat and protect hardware.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Cooling systems are unrelated to storage.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Display quality is unaffected by cooling.

questions.question: Q3 Which component is primarily responsible for moving air through a GPU cooling system?

explanations.a: Incorrect. Thermal paste improves heat transfer between surfaces.
explanations.b: Correct. Fans move air to help dissipate heat.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Power connectors only provide electrical power.
explanations.d: Incorrect. The PCB supports electronic components.

questions.question: Q4 What usually happens when a computer component becomes excessively hot?

explanations.a: Correct. High temperatures can reduce performance and reliability.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Overheating does not improve efficiency.
explanations.c: Incorrect. More cooling is typically required.

questions.question: Q5 Which of the following activities is most likely to increase GPU temperature?

explanations.a: Correct. Higher workloads require more power and generate more heat.
explanations.b: Incorrect. The monitor has little effect on GPU temperature.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Lower workloads generally reduce temperature.

questions.question: Q6 Which of the following best describes heat transfer?

answers.a: The movement of thermal energy from a hotter region to a cooler region
answers.b: The movement of electricity through a wire
answers.c: The conversion of heat into light
answers.d: The storage of heat inside a battery

explanations.a: Correct. Heat naturally flows from higher temperature regions to lower temperature regions.
explanations.c: Incorrect. This is not the definition of heat transfer.

questions.question: Q7 Which environment would generally make cooling a computer more difficult?

answers.c: A hot room with poor ventilation

explanations.c: Correct. High ambient temperatures and poor airflow hinder cooling.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Open spaces generally allow better heat dissipation.

questions.question: Q8 Why are heatsinks commonly used in electronic devices?

answers.b: To increase the surface area available for heat dissipation

explanations.a: Incorrect. Heatsinks do not store energy.
explanations.b: Correct. More surface area helps transfer heat to the surrounding air.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Signal amplification is performed by electronic circuits.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Heatsinks do not affect wireless communication.

questions.question: Q9 What is the most likely consequence of insufficient cooling in a computer system?

explanations.a: Incorrect. Poor cooling usually reduces performance.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Heat generation depends mainly on workload and power consumption.
explanations.c: Correct. Inadequate cooling causes temperatures to rise.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Insufficient cooling does not directly lower power consumption.

questions.question: Q10 Which factor would most likely increase the temperature inside a server room?

explanations.b: Correct. More operating systems generate additional heat.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Lower power generally means less heat.
